name: audacity4
description: Edit, clean up and master audio in Audacity 4 by talking to Claude.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a running Audacity 4 (the MCP-enabled build) over a local, token-authenticated bridge on 127.0.0.1:2212. 159 tools: editing, built-in and VST3 effects with live parameter control, labels, local Whisper transcription, loudness analysis and one-call cleanup/mastering pipelines for podcasts, voiceover, audiobooks and music. Everything runs locally; no audio leaves your machine.

Requires the Audacity4-Dev-MCP build of Audacity to be running. The auth token is read automatically from Audacity's profile directory.

profile.title: Tool profile
profile.description: Which tools to load: full (159 tools), cleanup, editing, mastering, transcription or minimal. Smaller profiles use less of Claude's context per message.

token.title: Bridge token override (optional)
token.description: Leave empty. Only needed if Audacity's profile folder is in an unusual place; paste the contents of its mcp_token file here.
